newsitem.title: USA: Negotiated muni sales total $415 mln for Sept 4.
newsitem.headline: Negotiated muni sales total $415 mln for Sept 4.

text.p: Negotiated municipal bond sales, depending on market conditions, are expected to total $415 million in seven offerings for Wednesday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
The largest issue is a $273.6 million New York State Thruway Authority issue through PaineWebber Inc.
Another $108 million are on the more tentative day-to-day calendar, meaning they might be priced Wednesday if market conditions allow it.
